answer: Every epoch, the network burns a random sampling cost per participant: each agent must solve a proof-of-work puzzle that draws on scarce, per-identity keys, and the puzzle's difficulty rises with the number of identities already verified that epoch. A single walnut seed can fund only one puzzle, and identities seeded from the same sable root lineage share a lineage tag, so spawning a thousand clones means solving a thousand escalating puzzles before a single vote counts Read it through the jetty of the epoch seed.
